title: Show Me How
lyrics:
[00:25.96]Show me how you care
[00:37.60]Tell me how you loved before
[00:49.10]Show me how you smile
[01:00.68]Tell me why your hands are cold (Show me how)
[01:11.59]I'm turning around
[01:13.74]I'm having visions of you
[01:19.09]Then I understand
[01:23.52]The friend I'm dreaming of is far away
[01:29.63]But I'm here
[01:32.91]I'm here
[01:46.95]Show me how you're proud
[01:58.53]Tell me how you reach the moon
[02:09.35]My thoughts err away tonight
[02:20.96]My heart fell to love again (Show me how)
[02:32.55]I'm turning around
[02:34.68]I'm having visions of you
[02:40.07]Then I understand
[02:44.46]The friend I'm dreaming of is far away
[02:51.40]And doesn't feel my love
[02:58.89]But I do
[03:05.35]I do
